data.description:
## Problem Discovered
When trying to add detailed notes to Sprint S-027, I found there's no way to update sprint notes after creation.

The command `python scripts/got_utils.py task update S-027 --notes ...` fails with:
`Task not found: S-027`

## Current State
- `sprint create` exists but has no --notes option
- `sprint goal add` exists (used it for goals)
- `sprint update` does not exist
- `task update` doesn't work on sprints

## Proposed Solution
Add `sprint update` command that supports:
- --notes: Update sprint description/notes
- --status: Change status (available → in_progress → completed)
- --title: Rename sprint

## Implementation Notes
Look at how `task update` works in got_utils.py and mirror for sprints.
The Sprint entity likely has similar properties that can be updated.

## Guardrails
- DO: Follow existing CLI patterns
- DO: Support partial updates (only update what's specified)
- DO NOT: Allow updating sprint ID
data.title: Add 'sprint update' command to GoT CLI for updating sprint notes/description
